subject: chemistry

hotspots.label: Atomic mass
hotspots.description: The atomic mass sits below the atomic number on the card — a decimal that averages the mass of all the element's isotopes.
hotspots.positionHint: The lower number position on the floating element card's face.
hotspots.function: Describes the average weight of the element's atoms.

hotspots.label: Atomic mass units
hotspots.description: Atomic mass is measured in amu — atomic mass units. One amu is about the mass of a single proton or neutron.
hotspots.positionHint: A small label marker above the card, near the mass value.
hotspots.function: Gives the unit that atomic masses are measured in.

hotspots.label: Protons + neutrons
hotspots.description: The coral protons and graphite neutrons in this cluster each weigh about 1 amu — together they make up nearly all of an atom's mass.
hotspots.positionHint: The nucleus cluster beside the card, weighed by the little scale when the mass-balance layer is on.
hotspots.function: Shows the protons and neutrons that supply the atomic mass.

hotspots.label: Isotope mix
hotspots.description: A row of carbon atoms with slightly different masses (carbon-12, -13, -14). The atomic mass is the weighted average of all of them.
hotspots.positionHint: The row of small atom clusters below the card, visible when the isotope-mix layer is on.
hotspots.function: Shows the isotope mixture that the atomic mass averages.

visualStyleNotes: Chemistry palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. The element card floats centered with a nucleus cluster and an isotope row, lit with soft neutral studio light — no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive anywhere. Clean stylized product-render look, specimen-quality not cartoon. Color on the mesh is restrained: the card is warm paper-white, protons warm coral, neutrons soft graphite, the isotope atoms are small muted clusters. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat hotspot dots (slate / amber / coral / molecular green accents from the Chemistry palette). Slow auto-rotation, calm, minimal chrome.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere, single 2K shared texture atlas. Element card: warm paper-white rounded tile, roughness ~0.6, subtle bevel. Proton spheres: warm desaturated coral, roughness ~0.45. Neutron spheres: soft graphite-grey, roughness ~0.55. Isotope atoms: small matte graphite clusters with coral cores. No emissive channels anywhere — any highlight or animation is handled by app runtime UI, not baked into the asset. Text on the card is rendered by the app UI layer.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: an element card (carbon) with its atomic mass, built to be read as 'the average weight of an element's atoms, explained by protons, neutrons, and isotopes.' Three procedural layers, all clean primitives:

1) MAIN: a thin rounded tile (card) ~2.0 x 1.3 floating centered, warm paper-white, subtle bevel — no text on mesh (app UI renders the numbers). Beside it on the left, a small nucleus cluster of 6 coral spheres + 6 graphite spheres (radius ~0.2) tightly packed.

2) MASS BALANCE (toggleable layer): a small stylized scale (two thin balanced pans on a slim stand, muted graphite) appears beneath the nucleus cluster; the cluster settles on one pan while a stack of small unit cubes (each ~1 amu) stacks on the other to equal it.

3) ISOTOPE MIX (toggleable layer): below the card, a row of 3 small atom clusters, all with 6 coral protons but with 6, 7, and 8 graphite neutrons (carbon-12, -13, -14). A faint bracket links all three to the atomic mass on the card, suggesting the average.

Camera: framed so the card is large and centered with the nucleus left and isotope row below; auto-rotate default. Budget 8-12k triangles. Named nodes: ElementCard, NucleusCluster, Proton_01-06, Neutron_01-06, MassScale, Isotope_12, Isotope_13, Isotope_14, AverageBracket. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer; no text on the mesh.
